0022600149.text: The New Orleans Pelicans, now 1-4 and 14th in the West, host the Atlanta Hawks, who are 3-3 and first in the Southeast, in the Pelicans' sixth game of the 2026-27 season. The teams have not met yet this season, and New Orleans lost the 2025-26 series 0-2, including a 117-100 loss at Atlanta on January 7, 2026. New Orleans is without Jordan Poole (ankle sprain) and Yves Missi (knee bruise), while Atlanta is missing Henri Veesaar (knee) and Mouhamed Gueye (foot fracture).
